description: This file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class for an Android app, responsible for rendering a vertical list of sections on the home screen, including a banner and multiple content rows with horizontal scrollers. It manages different view types, view holders, and their behavior, particularly focusing on layouts, focus handling, and aspect ratio calculations for the banner section.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for a RecyclerView that manages various section types on the home screen, including banners and content rows.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type for each position based on the section item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders for banner sections and content row sections.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to view holders based on the section item.

inner_classes.name: BannerSectionVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class for the banner section, which sets up a horizontal RecyclerView with snapping and focus behavior.

inner_classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual content rows, managing a horizontal list of content cards and focus behavior.

attributes.name: companion object
attributes.description: Defines view type constants and the DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation.

methods.name: SectionDiff
methods.description: DiffUtil callback for calculating differences between section items.
